verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a live REST API served under a /api/v1/ path, with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and documented rate limits. Nothing in the pack documents a versioning scheme, a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or change notices. A bare v1 URL segment does not show versioned APIs backed by a documented deprecation policy, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
